source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 6 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: In winter a thermometer can show below 0°, e.g. −5° (minus five degrees); such numbers are negative.
stages.headlineEnglish: In winter a thermometer can show below 0°, e.g. −5° (minus five degrees); such numbers are negative.

stages.headline: Negative numbers also describe heights: a point 20 m below sea level is −20 m, Aragats' peak is +4 090 m.
stages.headlineEnglish: Negative numbers also describe heights: a point 20 m below sea level is −20 m, Aragats' peak is +4 090 m.

stages.headline: Natural numbers, their negative opposites and 0 form the integers; 0 is neither positive nor negative.
stages.headlineEnglish: Natural numbers, their negative opposites and 0 form the integers; 0 is neither positive nor negative.

stages.headline: A submarine is 150 m below sea level. Write its position as a negative number.
